annotations.title: OFAC sanctions check, wallet: screen a crypto address or a name against the SDN list

description: OFAC sanctions check for a crypto wallet address or a person or company name: screens against the OFAC SDN list (EVM, Bitcoin, Tron, USDT and more) and returns a verdict (block, review, pass) with every match, its SDN id and programs. A screening aid, not legal advice. Use before paying or accepting funds from an address, when onboarding a counterparty, or as the compliance step of an agent payment flow. Example: address=0x098B716B8Aaf21512996dC57EB0615e2383E2f96. Price $0.009/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.

address.description: Crypto address to check (give address, name or both)

name.description: Person or company name; matches when every word appears in a listed name or alias
